channel.title: OnBusLaw: Blog
channel.description: News and explainers on online consumer and business law in the US, UK and EU: new rules, scams to watch for and how-tos checked against official sources.

item.title: Action Fraud is now Report Fraud: how to report a scam in the UK
item.description: The UK has replaced Action Fraud with Report Fraud. How to report a scam or cyber crime now, what happens next, and other ways to report scam texts and emails.

item.title: How to cancel a subscription: your rights in the US, UK and EU
item.description: Struggling to cancel a subscription? The 2026 rules: what happened to the FTC click-to-cancel rule, US state laws, UK reforms and EU cancellation rights.

item.title: Is this website legit? How to spot a fake online shop
item.description: Checks to run before buying from an unfamiliar website: business details, reviews, payment options, domain age and prices, and what to do if caught out.

item.title: The EU “withdraw from contract” button: what changed in June 2026
item.description: Since 19 June 2026, EU online traders must offer a “withdraw from contract” button. What the rule requires, who it covers and what it means for you.
